#!/bin/bash
# trial.sh <label> <wait-seconds> <extra qemu args...>
# Boots the win311 image with the given options, then reports text-mode VRAM
# contents and a PNG screenshot so a boot hang can be diagnosed.
set -u
LABEL="$1"; shift
WAIT="$1"; shift

sleep 1
rm -f /tmp/qemu-monitor.sock
nohup qemu-system-i386 \
  -drive file=/app/isos/win311.img,format=raw,if=ide,index=0,media=disk,snapshot=on \
  -vnc 0.0.0.0:1 -k en-us \
  -monitor unix:/tmp/qemu-monitor.sock,server,nowait \
  -boot c "$@" > /tmp/trial-$LABEL.log 2>&1 &
sleep "$WAIT"
qmon "screendump \"/tmp/trial-$LABEL.ppm\"" >/dev/null
qmon "pmemsave 0xb8000 4000 \"/tmp/trial-$LABEL.vram\"" >/dev/null
python3 - "$LABEL" <<'EOF'
import sys

#!/bin/bash
# Start Windows 3.11 for Workgroups in QEMU with VNC on :1 (port 5901),
# a QEMU monitor socket for programmatic keyboard input, and the base disk
# image kept immutable via snapshot mode.
#
# QEMU 5.2.0 is used because the win311.img image is only known to work with
# that release (newer QEMU TCG breaks Windows 386-enhanced-mode startup).
set -u

Q_ROOT=/app/qemu-5.2
Q_LD="$Q_ROOT/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/ld-2.31.so"
Q_LIBS="$Q_ROOT/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu:$Q_ROOT/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu"
Q_BIN="$Q_ROOT/usr/bin/qemu-system-i386"
IMG=/app/isos/win311.img
MON=/tmp/qemu-monitor.sock
QMP=/tmp/qemu-qmp.sock
LOG=/var/log/qemu-win311.log

mkdir -p /var/log
pkill -x qemu-system-i38 2>/dev/null
sleep 1
rm -f "$MON" "$QMP"

nohup "$Q_LD" --library-path "$Q_LIBS" "$Q_BIN" \
  -L "$Q_ROOT/usr/share/seabios" -L "$Q_ROOT/usr/share/qemu" \
  -name win311 \
  -M pc -cpu pentium -m 32 \
  -drive file="$IMG",format=raw,if=ide,index=0,media=disk,snapshot=on \
  -vga cirrus \
  -netdev user,id=net0 -device ne2k_pci,netdev=net0 \
  -vnc 0.0.0.0:1 -k en-us \
  -monitor unix:"$MON",server,nowait \
  -qmp unix:"$QMP",server,nowait \
  -usb -device usb-kbd \
  -rtc base=localtime -boot c \
  >> "$LOG" 2>&1 &

for _ in $(seq 1 100); do
  [ -S "$MON" ] && break
  sleep 0.2
done
echo "qemu started, monitor=$MON vnc=:1 (5901)"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Drive the Windows 3.11 VM to the desktop and verify it.

Sends Enter through the QEMU monitor socket to clear the startup dialogs
(Sound Blaster warning / Windows for Workgroups logon) and reports when the
Program Manager desktop is up, based on the VNC framebuffer size/content.
"""
import os
import socket
import sys
import time

MON = "/tmp/qemu-monitor.sock"


def mon(cmds, wait=0.4):
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    s.settimeout(5)
    s.connect(MON)
    time.sleep(0.3)
    out = ""
    try:
        out = s.recv(65536).decode(errors="replace")
    except Exception:
        pass
    for c in cmds:
        s.sendall((c + "\n").encode())
        time.sleep(wait)
        try:
            out += s.recv(65536).decode(errors="replace")
        except Exception:
            pass
    s.close()
    return out


def shot(path="/tmp/vm-screen.ppm"):
    if os.path.exists(path):
        os.unlink(path)
    mon(['screendump "%s"' % path])
    for _ in range(20):
        if os.path.exists(path) and os.path.getsize(path) > 0:
            break
        time.sleep(0.2)
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        hdr = f.read(64).split()
        w, h = int(hdr[1]), int(hdr[2])
        data = f.read()
    return w, h, data


def is_desktop(w, h, data):
    """Program Manager up: graphics mode plus many distinct colours."""
    if (w, h) == (720, 400):
        return False
    colors = {data[i:i + 3] for i in range(0, min(len(data), 3 * w * h), 3 * 97)}
    return len(colors) > 12


def main():
    deadline = time.time() + float(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 420)
    last = None
    while time.time() < deadline:
        w, h, data = shot()
        state = (w, h, len(data), hash(data))
        if is_desktop(w, h, data):
            print("desktop up: %dx%d" % (w, h))
            return 0
        if state == last:
            # screen settled on a dialog -> acknowledge it
            mon(["sendkey ret"])
        last = state
        time.sleep(10)
    print("timeout waiting for desktop")
    return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/bin/bash
# Publish the VM's VNC display over HTTP on port 80.
#
# /etc/nginx/nginx.conf (shipped with this container) already proxies port 80
# to 127.0.0.1:8080, so websockify serves the noVNC client there and bridges
# the WebSocket to the QEMU VNC server on 127.0.0.1:5901.
set -u

LOG=/var/log/websockify.log
PIDFILE=/var/run/websockify.pid
mkdir -p /var/log

if [ -f "$PIDFILE" ] && kill -0 "$(cat "$PIDFILE")" 2>/dev/null; then
    kill "$(cat "$PIDFILE")"
    sleep 1
fi

nohup websockify --web /usr/share/novnc 0.0.0.0:8080 127.0.0.1:5901 >> "$LOG" 2>&1 &
echo $! > "$PIDFILE"

nginx -t
if pgrep -x nginx >/dev/null; then
    nginx -s reload
else
    nginx
fi
sleep 1
echo "web interface: http://localhost/vnc.html  (nginx :80 -> websockify :8080 -> vnc :5901)"
